title: cracked ores
description: A simple resource pack that gives every ore a cracked appearance, making mineral blocks stand out with a unique and worn-looking style while staying faithful to Minecraft's vanilla aesthetic.
body: Give Minecraft's ores a fresh new look with this resource pack that redesigns every ore block using cracked and fractured textures. From coal and iron to diamonds, each ore features detailed cracks that make it more visually distinct while maintaining the game's vanilla style. The updated textures blend naturally with the surrounding stone and deepslate, creating a unique appearance without feeling out of place. Whether you're mining deep underground or exploring vast cave systems, these redesigned ores add extra character and detail to resource gathering while keeping gameplay completely unchanged.
